title: Suburban-SOC Rule Response Playbook
description: Structured representation of one per-rule playbook entry, migrated from docs/playbooks/IR_Sigma_Playbook.md. Mirrors that document's own 5-subsection shape (Rule Summary & MITRE Mapping / Automated Extraction Fields / Enrichment Criteria / Containment Decision Flow / Remediation & Evidence Preservation) rather than inventing a new structure, so migration is lossless and reviewable against the source.

id.description: Matches the rule's filename stem exactly, e.g. 'proc_creation_win_bitsadmin_download'. This is the anchor id in the source Markdown and the filename stem under rules/sigma/ or rules/suricata/.

title.description: The rule's human-readable name, from the ##### heading.

ruleFile.description: Repo-relative path to the rule definition, e.g. 'rules/sigma/proc_creation_win_bitsadmin_download.yml'.

category.description: Rule family, e.g. 'Windows Process Creation'. Must be one of playbooks/schema/enums.json#/category.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date this structured record was generated/last synced from the source Markdown, used for the drift check.

mitre.description: Structured MITRE ATT&CK mapping extracted from subsection 1's table.

aiContext.description: Machine-consumable pointer for the AI triage layer (build-prompt Phase 16) — never the rendered HTML, never scraped.

sections.description: The 5 fixed subsections, in source order. Content within each is preserved as structured sub-blocks (paragraph / table / list / codeBlock / queryBlock) rather than raw HTML.

language.description: For codeBlock/queryBlock: 'bash', 'kql', 'zeek', etc. Used to route to CommandBlock vs QueryBlock rendering (build-prompt Phase 11).

evidence.description: Evidence-collection instructions extracted from the Remediation & Evidence Preservation subsection, surfaced separately for the EvidenceBlock component.

unmappedContent.description: Build-prompt Phase 8 fallback: any source content that could not be reliably mapped into a structured block is preserved here verbatim rather than discarded, with the issue documented in the migration report.
